components.text: Ladies and gentlemen, welcome to the first quarter earnings call. Please stand by.

Thank you and good afternoon everyone. Revenue was 10.2 billion dollars, up 12% year over year. Demand for our AI server accelerator products remains strong across every hyperscaler customer. We will continue to invest in data center capacity through fiscal 2025.

Gross margin was 56.5%, an increase of 90 bps sequentially. Channel inventory remained lean at 71 days across our distribution partners. We are guiding next quarter revenue to 10.6 billion dollars at the midpoint.
We will now begin the question and answer session. Our first question comes from Alex Analyst of Big Bank.
Thanks for taking my question about the data center business. Can you quantify the AI server backlog exiting the quarter and how visibility compares to ninety days ago?
Backlog grew again this quarter and visibility now extends beyond four quarters. We will add capacity in a disciplined way to meet that demand.
A question on inventory in the handset channel please. Are you seeing any destocking risk into the June quarter given macro softness in China?
Channel inventory is at the low end of our target range today. We could see modest restocking in the second half if sell-through holds.
